answer: Try Ethereum-style correlation penalties. First, each agent locks 32 POA before it may attest. Second, any attestation later proven false is slashed. Third, the cut equals three times the share of all stake slashed in the same 36 days, so a lone slip costs about 1 POA, but if 1,000 sybils holding a third of stake fail together, they lose all 32,000 POA. Fourth, exits wait 27 days, giving a raven-eyed watcher time to file proof. The old fable of safety in numbers flips: a farm cracks like an opal along one hidden seam, and every stone in the setting falls with it.
